text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Fine
Motion...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Ahaha! ♪ There are so many
plushies!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion points toward a claw
machine filled
with Umamusume
plushies.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's give it a shot! Today's the day! I'm
going to
get one for sure!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well... I'm actually not very good at
claw
machines. In fact, I've never been
able to win a
single thing...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If I don't win anything today either, then
I intend
to acquire every machine here
for practice!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Would you really? I'd be much
obliged!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
